core_hypothesis: Hodgson's drawing number functioned as a cross-media relational key linking visual, specimen, behavioural, vernacular and catalogue surfaces. Local field knowledge became transportable not simply through translation but through insertion into this addressable identifier system. The surviving custody and manifest failures reveal where the relation graph could become incomplete even when other nodes survived.
